drivers.name: Promotion: 10% off
drivers.evidence: Noise-adjusted uplift from 6 past promotions: x1.49; this is a smaller discount (10% vs 15-30%), so reduce lift to x1.40. No evidence of over- or under-shoot.

adjustment.analysis: Labor Day historically has no lift (noise-adjusted x1.0). The 10% discount is smaller than past promotions (15-30% off), but the noise-adjusted uplift for similar promotions is x1.49. The classical model's 49% uplift is plausible but slightly high for a 10% discount. Recent back-to-school season saw spikes (x2.15), but this week lacks that driver. No evidence of pantry loading. Adjusting downward from the model's 1.49 to 1.40 based on discount size and noise adjustment. Spread unchanged: baseline uncertainty is well-calibrated.
